verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs say admins can audit every action an agent takes from one org-wide admin dashboard. That is a first-party audit capability, but it covers only AI-agent actions, not all user and workspace activity. The developer-platform 'logs' feature is an app-building primitive and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented workspace-wide audit log covering human user actions (logins, permission changes, board edits/deletions), details on filtering, export or retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
